summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the admission of 8,855 additional ordinary shares to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under a block admission dated 29 January 2021, covering shares issued between 1 July 2026 and 31 July 2026 under employee share schemes. Total shares in issue post-admission were 1,551,033,389, fully fungible with existing ordinary shares. This routine administrative listing notification does not constitute a special situation; it reflects standard equity issuance under employee compensation plans with no transaction terms, premium, or strategic element.
